t: 前拜占庭皇帝罗马诺斯四世·狄奥根内斯被凯撒·约翰·杜卡斯(英语:Cesar John Douk…
te: Former Byzantine Emperor Romanos IV Diogenes is blinded on command of caesar John Doukas.
dz: 前拜占庭皇帝罗马诺斯四世·狄奥根内斯被凯撒·约翰·杜卡斯(英语:Cesar John Doukas)所指挥而失明.
de: Former Byzantine Emperor Romanos IV Diogenes is blinded on command of caesar John Doukas.

t: 阿瓦尔人和萨萨尼德人围攻君士坦丁堡,由拜占庭军队在帕特里森·博努斯(英语:Patrician …
te: The Avars and Sassanids besiege Constantinople, held by Byzantine troops under Patrician Bonus.
dz: 阿瓦尔人和萨萨尼德人围攻君士坦丁堡,由拜占庭军队在帕特里森·博努斯(英语:Patrician Bonus)下所持.
de: The Avars and Sassanids besiege Constantinople, held by Byzantine troops under Patrician Bonus.

t: 曹瑞接任父亲为魏国皇帝.
te: Cao Rui succeeds his father as emperor of Wei.
dz: 曹瑞接任父亲为魏国皇帝.
de: Cao Rui succeeds his father as emperor of Wei.
